change: Transfer an accepted public card from its transient flight to the reserved public-row face once, and protect the table sidebar from all overlay drawing.
behavior: A matching public row face and actor caption reserve layout while hidden during flight, including presentation delay.
At 37 percent of its cue duration the static face takes over and the overlay stops drawing that face.
Repositioning an arrived public row does not restart its flight. A replaced row retires the previous card flight.
Motion off, reset, cue source replacement, anchor root replacement, expiry and unload restore hidden public faces.
The table sidebar is excluded from all overlay drawing and from floating combat text placement.

baseline.issue: Public row face and caption visible before native local card arrived.

motion.note: 24 native WPF render frames each, injected presentation clock. This is not physical foreground acceptance or measured screen FPS.

Sorting and drawing preserve accepted command count and every player-safe snapshot.
Delayed attack/response arrivals, replaced rows and lifecycle interruptions were checked.
